content.title: Apple TV: Shows, Movies & More - Apps on Google Play
content.text: Apple TV is the home of exclusive Apple Original shows and movies, Formula 1® (for US-based customers), MLS, and Friday Night Baseball — all in one place.With an Apple TV subscription:• Stream hundreds of Apple Originals—thrilling dramas, epic sci-fi, and feel-good comedies—including Emmy®-winning series like The Studio, Severance, The Morning Show, Slow Horses, and Ted Lasso; global hits like Shrinking, Your Friends & Neighbors, Hijack, and Monarch: Legacy of Monsters; and Apple Original Films like The Gorge and record-breaking blockbuster F1 The Movie.• Enjoy new releases weekly, with no ads.• Watch every Formula 1 Grand Prix™ live—with all-access coverage for every practice, qualifying, Sprint, and race.• Watch every Major League Soccer match live throughout the regular season, the entire playoffs, and Leagues Cup, all with no blackouts.• Watch Friday Night Baseball, with live MLB matchups every Friday of the regular season.Apple TV app makes all your watching all your TV easier:• Get personalized recommendations across everything you watch• With Continue Watching, pick up where you left off across all your subscriptions anddevices.• Add to Watchlist to keep track of what you want to watch later.Apple TV subscription does not include third party subscription services or content available for rent or purchase in the Apple TV app.The availability of Apple TV features, channels, and related content may vary depending on the country or region from which you attempt to access them. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your Settings on the Apple TV app after purchase. For the privacy policy, see https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/en-ww and for Apple TV app terms and conditions, visit https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/us/terms.html
